parts.gloss: those things worthy of being learned

words.gloss: those things worthy of being learned

literal: Learn flawlessly those things worthy of being learned; after learning, stand in accordance with that.
translation: Learn thoroughly and without error what is worthy of being learned; and having learned, let your conduct be worthy of your learning.
modern: கற்க வேண்டியவற்றைத் தங்கு தடையின்றித் தெளிவாகக் கற்க வேண்டும்; அவ்வாறு கற்ற பிறகு, கற்ற கல்விக்கு ஏற்ப நல்வழியில் நடக்க வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the complete path of true education. First, one must choose to learn only what is worthy and beneficial. Second, this learning must be done flawlessly (kacaṭaṟa), leaving no room for doubts or errors. Finally, the ultimate test of education is conduct; after learning (kaṟṟapin), one must live and act in perfect alignment (niṟka athaṟkuth thaka) with that knowledge.
